title: Plasmid Isolation: Miniprep Protocol for GeneJET Kit
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7j4hkqw

steps.title: Harvest Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the overnight culture at 4700rpm for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 250 µL Resuspension solution and transfer the mixture to an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL Lysis solution to the tube and invert 4-6 times.

steps.title: Neutralize Lysate
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Neutralization solution to the tube and invert 4-6 times.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 5 minutes, then transfer the supernatant to a GeneJET spin column tube and centrifuge for 1 minute.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to GeneJET spin column tube
Empty the flowthrough and place the column back in the collection tube

steps.title: Wash DNA Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice using Wash buffer to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Wash buffer and centrifuge for 1 minute
Discard the flowthrough and place the column back
Repeat the wash step (add 500 µL Wash buffer and centrifuge for 1 minute)

steps.title: Remove Residual Ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for an additional minute to remove all residual ethanol, then place the column in a fresh Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Elute Purified DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column using Elution buffer or MilliQ water.

substeps.instruction: Add 25-50 µL of either Elution buffer or MilliQ to the column
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute

steps.title: Store Purified DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the column and store the purified DNA at -20ºC.
